_README: REVIEWED value corrections for docs/sf_fundamentals.json cells (npStd/npCon).
NOT for scale errors -- those are scale_fix.json (power-of-ten, applied at PARSE time).
This ledger is for cells whose stored VALUE is simply wrong against the filing itself:
the wrong period, the wrong line, or a mis-transcription. Every entry states the primary
document and a SECOND independent document, because a single quote can be a typo and a
restatement looks exactly like an error until you check whether the later filing agrees.
Applied by scripts/apply_fund_cell_fix.py, guarded on `was` so it is idempotent and can
never overwrite a value someone else has since corrected. Measured 2026-08-23: pre-2016
cells in sf_fundamentals.json are NOT regenerated by the nightly (HINDUNILVR 20071231 held
473.79 unchanged across 40 commits), so a written correction persists; wiring this ledger
into build_fundamentals.py is still the durable follow-up for any era that IS rebuilt.

fixes.why: PRE-LISTING YEAR-SHIFTED DUPLICATE: stored value was a verbatim copy of the SAME QUARTER ONE YEAR LATER (identical value AND ann date). As-filed from Shalby's Q1FY19 NSE filing (13-Aug-2018 'Outcome of BM with Q1 Unaudited Results'), Statement of Unaudited STANDALONE results, (Rs in Million): headers 'Quarter ended June 30 2018 | March 31 2018 | June 30 2017' + 'Year ended March 31 2018'; 'Profit/(Loss) for the period (IX+XII)' = 121.35 | 177.51 | 75.66 | 423.62 -> Jun-17 = 75.66 Mn = 7.57 cr. Col 1 reproduces our stored Jun-2018 12.13 (121.35 Mn). The Jun-2017 column carries PRE-IPO paid-up capital 886.55 Mn vs 1,080.10 later, confirming it is the pre-listing quarter; EPS 0.86 x 88.655 Mn shares = 75.6 EXACT. (Shalby listed 2017-12-15.)

PRE-LISTING YEAR-SHIFTED DUPLICATE: stored 1.15 was a verbatim copy of Mar-2019 (identical value AND ann date). AGROPHOS is an NSE SME listing (main-board first bar 2019-03-08) and in FY2018 it reported HALF-YEARLY, so no Mar-2018 quarter was ever filed on its own; the quarter exists only as a comparative in its later quarterly-era filings. EVIDENCE FOR 0.13: (a) its own AUDITED FY2018 statement (NSE zip FINANCIALRESULTSUPDATE_29052018153704_250, 29-May-2018, Amount in Lakhs) prints 6-months-ended 31.03.2018 Net Profit = 60.46 and Year-Ended 31.03.2018 = 89.82, and 60.46+29.36(H1)=89.82 EXACT, cross-checked by the balance sheet's reserves movement 1695.38->1785.20 = 89.82; (b) Moneycontrol splits that same half-year as Dec-2017 0.47 + Mar-2018 0.13, i.e. 47.02+13.44 = 60.46 lakh, reproducing the AUDITED half-year to 0.02 lakh; (c) the Q4FY19 filing's XBRL carries a ProfitLossForPeriod fact of 1,344,000 (=13.44 lakh) on contextRef FourD. CAVEAT recorded honestly: that XBRL instance is MALFORMED - it references OneD/FourD/OneI but never DECLARES those contexts, so FourD's period cannot be read from the file; the 2018 dating is inferred from its sibling FourReportableSegment*D contexts (2018-01-01..2018-03-31). The identity in (a)+(b) is what licenses this value, not the XBRL alone.
